faqs.a:
(a)
Annual inspection program.
It shall be unlawful for any person to fail or refuse to submit an annual inspection
               report as required under this article.
(b)
Uncontrolled cross-connection.
It shall be unlawful for any person to make, install, maintain, permit, or allow
               an uncontrolled cross-connection.
(c)
Inspection.
It shall be unlawful for any person to make, install, maintain, permit or allow a
               backflow prevention assembly or method that has not been tested or inspected in accordance
               with the provisions of this article.
(1)
It shall be unlawful for any person to fail to provide the results of a backflow prevention
               assembly test or of an inspection required under this article upon request of the
               director.
(d)
Refusal to allow entry.
It shall be unlawful for any person who owns or occupies property upon which a cross-connection
               is located to refuse to allow the director to survey or inspect the property in accordance
               with the provisions of this article.
(e)
Failure to obey.
It shall be unlawful for any person to fail to obey an order, rule, or regulation
               issued by the director under this article. For purpose of this subsection (e),"fail
               to obey" means and includes a customer's failure to test a backflow prevention method
               or assembly pursuant to this article.
(f)
Uncertified technician.
It shall be unlawful for any person who knows or should know that he or she is not
               a certified cross-connection control technician, or whose certification is invalid,
               to:
(1)
Hold himself or herself out to another person as being a certified cross-connection
               control technician;
(2)
In exchange for anything of value, conduct any test or inspection required under this
               article; or
(3)
Submit to the city any report required under this article, except that an employee
               of company by whom a certified technician is employed may submit a report.
(g)
Invalid report.
It shall be unlawful for any person to submit a test or inspection report required
               by this article that is not complete and correct in every respect.
(h)
Illegal to test without certification.
It shall be unlawful for any person who holds himself or herself out to be a certified
               technician or who performs or attempts to perform a test or inspection required under
               this article to fail to immediately provide proof that he or she is a certified technician
               upon request of the director.
(i)
Illegal to remove a posted termination notice.
It shall be unlawful for any person to deface, render illegible, or remove a termination
               notice that has been posted on a property by order of the director under this article
               without the prior written permission of the director.
(
Ord. No. 4829
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
